anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: Before the sustained upset, reflux was 0.331 L/h and distillate flow was 0.338 L/h.
Reflux collapsed to 0.004 L/h while distillate flow rose to 1.488 L/h.
System pressure fell from 649.409 to 392.310 mbar; PDI701 fell from 0.980 to 0.381 mbar while PDI702 rose from 1.989 to 6.896 mbar.
Upset persists: reflux 0.006 L/h, distillate 1.286 L/h, system pressure 400.862 mbar, and differential pressures 0.339 and 6.481 mbar.
Temperatures have fallen to 64.818, 48.762, and 32.823 °C, respectively, corroborating a process disturbance.

args.missing_evidence: Protocol step and commanded pressure, reflux, and withdrawal settings are needed to exclude a scheduled transition; independent pressure/flow checks and valve, vacuum, and condenser status are needed to identify the cause. No composition measurement or separation acceptance criterion is provided.
